thread:
maria.g: Hey team — nightly RAG eval shows a 12% absolute drop in top5 recall on prod index vs last night.
lee.k: :eyes: that's big. Any change rolled last 24h?
ashwin: I pushed the quantized-embedder PR yesterday (commit ab3f9c). It was supposed to reduce memory.
olivia: Can you paste the eval summary? numbers?
maria.g: Sure, snippets:

```
metric | baseline | current
-------|----------|--------
top1_recall | 0.62 | 0.51
top5_recall | 0.87 | 0.75
reranker_auc | 0.78 | 0.64
avg_cos_sim | 0.34 | 0.27
```

maria.g: Also seeing more hallucinations in generated answers for few queries.
ashwin: avg_cos_sim drop suggests embedding drift. Did the index get rebuilt?
lee.k: Index rebuild started 30m ago, completed before the PR deploy. logs show vectors uploaded.
infra-bot: INDEX_REBUILD finished - 1841298600 - size 2.1M vectors
olivia: Could be normalization bug in quantized pipeline. I remember a change in L2 norm step.
ashwin: Oh right — I used a fused kernel that outputs half precision and forgot renormalize to float32.
maria.g: That would shrink norms; cosine sim would drop. Any quick test we can run?
ashwin: Run this locally on a sample: `python -m embed_tests.compare --commit ab3f9c --baseline v1.9 --sample 1000`
lee.k: Running now... partial output:

```
mean_norm_baseline  "1.003"
mean_norm_current   "0.742"
```

lee.k: Confirms norms ~0.74. That explains sim drop.
olivia: Proposed fix: re-normalize embeddings right after quantize kernel. Quick patch:

```
vec = quant_kernel(x)
vec = vec / np.linalg.norm(vec, axis=1, keepdims=True)
```

ashwin: I'll open a hotfix PR and roll forward to canary only.
maria.g: Can we also rollback reranker tweak? I noticed a small hyperparam change the same deploy.
lee.k: Reranker PR was minor (lambda=0.22 -> 0.25). I don't think that explains cosine shift but could amplify.
olivia: Rollout plan: patch embed norm, canary to 5% traffic, run nightly eval subset at +1h, if top5_recall >= baseline -1% then promote.
ashwin: PR: github.com/redwood/embeds/pull/1287
maria.g: Thanks. Assigning myself to monitor eval-bot outputs. eval-bot, please run targeted RAG suite after deploy.
eval-bot: scheduled runs: rag-regression-suite on canary - ETA 45m
maria.g: Great. If canary looks good we can avoid full index rebuild (we can re-normalize stored vectors in place though).
lee.k: I'll prepare a small script to renormalize the index if needed.
ashwin: Pushing fix now. ETA ~20m.
olivia: :thumbsup: \nmaria.g: Noted - keep updates here. If anyone sees high error rates in logs, ping #eng-oncall.
lee.k: Will do. Thanks team.
